settings.description: Default vault cap for new rounds
Default profit percentage for new rounds
Percent of vaults that secretly will not fill (no payout). Higher = house wins more often. 70 = house wins ~70% of rounds.
Max % of the vault cap a single real user may stake in one round. Stops a single player from buying the whole vault. 25 = 25% of cap.
Max % of the vault cap that may be staked from any single IP address (across all accounts) per round. Soft Sybil defense.
How long an unfilled vault lives before it silently expires.
Min % of cap bots will push a no-fill vault to.
Max % of cap bots will push a no-fill vault to.
Seconds between vault eruption and auto-payout.
